concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior ('Scaffold-only tasks ... are dropped; the platform supplies common packages')
concerns.text: No task delivers the pinned `code/requirements.txt` (or pyproject.toml). The constitution's Reproducibility Requirements mandate it and the Code-Execution Agent builds an isolated venv from it; 'the platform supplies common packages' does not satisfy this. T013's fresh-checkout verification will fail without a task producing the pinned dependency file (incl. pwlf, statsmodels, sentence-transformers).

metrics.schema.yaml REQUIRES a `breakpoint_estimate` field on every (library_size, pruning_enabled) aggregation group, but plan.md/T008 define a single primary breakpoint from the baseline configuration only. T010's implementer must either fabricate per-group breakpoints (contradicting the primary-vs-supplemental rule) or emit schema-invalid output. The task does not say which; it is not deterministically executable as written.

Path identifiers disagree across artifacts: plan.md references `specs/001-gene-regulation/...` while the actual spec/contracts dir is `specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-from-chatbot/`. T001 says schemas must live at root `contracts/` 'exactly matching' the read-only schemas — but the read-only source path is ambiguous under the two identifiers, and T012/T013 write into the spec dir whose canonical name is unresolved. An implementer cannot resolve the target paths deterministically.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T004/T008 vs plan.md:Project Structure and data-model.md:Experiment Log
concerns.text: The per-task log filename is `data/results/experiment_log.csv` in tasks.md (T004, T008 reads `experiment_log*.csv`) but `data/results/metrics.csv` in plan.md Phase Ordering and data-model.md. T004's deliverable path and T008's input glob are not resolvable against the plan/data-model; the implementer gets contradictory file targets.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs plan.md:Summary/Performance Goals ('2 pruning flags', '12 primary experimental configurations')
concerns.text: T007's three-arm sweep (off / FR-004 / redundancy variant) is not reflected in plan.md, which specifies 2 pruning flags. The redundancy variant is a reasonable empirical answer to the reviewer objection, but the plan-level design was never updated, so T007's factorial (4×3×3) has no authorizing design doc; the implementer cannot tell which sweep is authoritative.

T002 requires exactly 768-dim embeddings per skill.schema.yaml, but data-model.md says 'variable' dimension. Minor, but T002's verification ('validates against skill.schema.yaml') depends on which source the implementer treats as authoritative; align the data model.

T005's verification command uses CLI flags (`--pruning false`, `--task-sample`) that no task specifies as the agent's interface, and `--pruning false` conflicts with T007's three-state pruning flag (off/FR-004/redundancy). Define the CLI contract (flag names, accepted values) so the verification command is runnable as written.
